title: Connector machine facts and settings
description: What the machine reports about itself and what the hub sets on it (C-05.18, C-05.19), for the machine registry and Settings > Machines. Folder and settings objects are contract 06's (06-connector-state.json); versions travel in hello (contract 12).

machine_facts.description: The machine as the connector sees it (C-05.18). Sent after every hello.ack and whenever a value changes; always whole. Direction: connector to hub.

ch.description: The channel this frame travels on (C-05.10).

kind.description: The frame kind within its channel.

id.description: This frame's id, unique per sender per connection. A reply names it in `re`.

seq.description: Per connection, per channel, per direction: 1 for the first frame, plus 1 for each next (C-05.11). Durable positions live in the bodies (contract 07 cursors, hub_msg_id, contract 06 rev), never here.

at.description: When the sender built the frame. Informative; never used for ordering or expiry.

items.description: One offered folder, contract 06's object unchanged.

folders.description: Every folder offered on the machine, whole. The only paths the hub learns.

settings.description: The settings in force: the hub's last machine.settings with the local ceiling applied (contract 06, C-06.23).

mcp_servers.description: The MCP servers installed for Claude Code on this machine, by name only (design panel F). Never a command line, an argument, an env value or a path.

skills.description: The skills installed for Claude Code on this machine, by name only (design panel F). Never a command line, an argument, an env value or a path.

ceiling.description: The machine's ceiling for relayed requests (06 C-06.23a, set by connect ceiling, default full): every daemon on this machine serves a relayed request at most at this level. Informative to the hub, which shows it on the machine page; it never raises a decision.

machine_settings.description: The hub's settings for the machine (C-05.19). Sent after every hello.ack and on every change. The connector answers with machine.facts. Direction: hub to connector.

settings.description: What Settings > Machines sets (design panel F), in contract 06's field names.

paused.description: Pause (C-05.27): the hub withholds its own queue deliveries and the connector launches no session; running turns finish. The framed composer still queues, Send now and a declared wake: 'immediate' signal still wake the agent, and a paused chat can still be stopped (Stop is a relayed control at Message).

rev.description: The hub's revision of these settings; the connector ignores an older one.

machine_revoked.description: Disconnect in Settings > Machines, or a revoke (C-05.9). The hub closes with 4403 next; the connector runs contract 06's C-06.9. Direction: hub to connector.
